content: The University of Ottawa Heart Institute was established in 1976 by Dr. Wilbert J. Keon. It was originally founded on the premises of the Ottawa Civic Hospital. Initially functioning as a department within the hospital, it has since grown into Canada’s sole comprehensive cardiac care center. The Institute provides a full spectrum of services, including prevention, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, research, and education, all dedicated to cardiovascular health. It maintains affiliations with both The Ottawa Hospital and the University of Ottawa.
